detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for downloads or execution of binaries named 'octane.exe', especially those matching the provided SHA256 hashes. Inspect network traffic for connections to the listed domains and IP addresses, particularly outbound requests to octane[.]lol or any *.noxia[.]cloud subdomains. Use endpoint detection to flag executables that contain hardcoded references to these domains or that initiate unexpected network connections shortly after execution.
